# Ornella Vee

> Ornella Vee is a self-published author of contemporary and dark romance novels: second chance romances, rockstar romances and morally gray heroes with slow-burn tension. Her books are The List and The Risk, with the mafia romance Roman releasing in January 2027.

## Books

- The List (The Redemption Series): a second chance, celebrity crush romance about a single mom who starts over in a new country with a bucket list. Goodreads: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/242964872-the-list
- The Risk (The Redemption Series): a second chance rockstar romance about a single mom and kindergarten teacher whose rockstar ex, Declan Evans, returns wanting to know his daughter. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GZWTLKXD Goodreads: https://www.goodreads.com/en/book/show/251937890-the-risk
- Roman (January 2027): a mafia romance about a runaway bride and a dangerous stranger.

## About the author

- Ornella Vee works in corporate strategy, PR and digital marketing in Dubai and writes romance in every spare moment.
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/Ornella-Vee-Ornella-Vee/author/B0FX2ZMTMJ
- Goodreads author page: https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/60854786.Ornella_Vee_Ornella_Vee
